goal: Detect correlation shifts and oscillatory noise before adaptive stopping and fall back to full-budget decision using only acquired prefix.

pilot.disclosure: Inspected before freeze; not holdout. Repaired pilot bug where an alarm wrongly forced unresolved instead of fixed240 final decision.

rule.predecision: SG035 rho bins from t0..109; existing SG034 risk budget .08
rule.monitor: From currently collected continuation prefix take last 80 samples; detrend with linear least squares; compute residual lag-1 autocorrelation and root mean square. Alarm if lag-1 autocorrelation > .78 OR residual RMS > .29.
rule.alarm: Latch alarm; disallow early stopping thereafter; at 240 use fixed240 classification rather than a forced unresolved.
rule.no_alarm: Use original SG030 conservative adaptive 2-consecutive eligible classifications with slope outer margins .0036 or .0014.

caveats: Checks only every 40 observations; shifts preceding an early stop may be undetectable.
Synthetic known scenarios; fresh seeds but not real-world distribution.
